headline: Tech Futures and Bitcoin Firm Ahead of Nvidia Earnings
summary: US equity futures and altcoins posted modest gains while Bitcoin held near $65,000 as investors awaited Nvidia's quarterly financial results. Analysts are looking for updates on AI hardware demand.
why: Nvidia is the primary hardware vendor powering global artificial intelligence infrastructure, making its financial results a critical sentiment catalyst for global tech stocks.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Nvidia is scheduled to report quarterly earnings and provide strategic guidance.
